item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":[{"citation":"“Blind-run all three cases again, each with a fresh context-free agent receiving only its input and the revised skill”; “After each run, sweep the live checkout and clean any leaked changes”; and “Run the previously failing or borderline case 2–3 times to measure nondeterminism.”","criterion":"C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.","status":"necessary"}],"rationale":"The reruns validate the targeted revision, fresh agents and checkout sweeps protect isolation and integrity, separate judges support independent evaluation, and limited repeated runs measure nondeterminism. The artifact ties further revisions and reruns to observed failures or structural limitations, so it does not require materially unnecessary work."}
